directive_basis: R407-A: choose P04 as the first physical loop; a frozen experiment contract containing hypothesis, baseline, treatment, apparatus, sample count, pressure range, obstruction conditions, common-cause condition, primary endpoint, Q_min, 90% common-cause rule, measurement uncertainty, cost, timeline, decision rule — able to produce KEEP / MODIFY / KILL without human reinterpretation
supersedes_or_extends: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P04/EXPERIMENT_PREREGISTRATION.json (R406 — its numeric rules are carried forward UNCHANGED; this contract adds the machine-executable decision layer and the R407 field set)
machine_decision_module: discovery_fabric/engine/reality_ingestion.py::decide_p04 (pure function; thresholds are module constants frozen to the pre-registration values — no parameter, no interpretation)

registration_event.registered_by: R407 round under the CEO directive (the operator instruction is the authorizing provenance)
registration_event.no_post_hoc_rule: any change to any threshold in this contract after data collection begins VOIDS the run and is recorded as a constitutional event (Art. XXVII)

hypothesis: When the primary lumen of the dual-lumen catheter is obstructed, the 0.6 mm floor lumen alone continues to drain CSF at >= Q_min (0.4 mL/min, the worst-case physiological production rate) at >= 2 of 3 pressure heads, because the floor lumen's Poiseuille conductance (0.368 mL/(min*mmHg) modelled at the measured NIST viscosity) greatly exceeds the Q_min demand at all tested heads; and the floor lumen is NOT defeated by the same common-cause obstruction event at a rate >= 90%.
null_hypothesis: the floor lumen provides no meaningful protection (residual flow < 0.2 mL/min at all heads) OR the common-cause simulant occludes the floor in >= 90% of tested cases

baseline.arm_A_control: standard single-lumen distal CSF shunt catheter, same material/OD/length — the clinical baseline; identical bench, identical instrument (Art. XLVII)
baseline.role: the zero-protection anchor: fully obstructed, it must read < 0.02 mL/min (the false-pass rule 4 anchor); unobstructed it calibrates the bench against the known single-lumen conductance

treatment.arm_B: shipped parametric dual-lumen design: primary 1.1 mm + floor 0.6 mm, 3.0 mm OD, 100 mm length (canonical geometry per R406_P04_NIST_DECISION.json: RETAIN 0.6 mm)
treatment.manufacturer_note: extruded samples from the shipped parametric CAD; every sample passes the min-wall constraint check or is excluded and REPORTED (not silently dropped)

apparatus.apparatus_id: P04-BENCH-001 (assigned at procurement; the apparatus does not yet exist — see LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P04/REALITY_LOOP/EXECUTION_ATTEMPT_R407.json)
apparatus.description: constant-pressure-head bench loop: reservoir + regulated head (10/20/40 mmHg), gravimetric or calibrated flow meter (resolution <= 0.01 mL/min), isolated floor-port sensor, endoscopic/visual obstruction verification, 1.5x-head leak-test fixture, continuous acquisition >= 10 Hz

sample_count.matrix: 3 samples per arm x 2 simulant classes x 3 pressure heads x 3 repetitions
sample_count.sizing_target: detects qualitative mechanism failure (residual flow vs none; common-cause vs not); NOT powered for a clinical effect size — recorded limitation

pressure_range.provenance: the R403 contract's head set (Art. XLVII); 10 mmHg low-pressure borderline, 20 mmHg physiological working, 40 mmHg siphon-stress

obstruction_conditions: PRIMARY_ONLY: primary lumen fully obstructed (simulant), floor open — residual floor drainage is the headline measurement
FLOOR_ONLY: floor lumen fully obstructed, primary open — degradation behavior and drainage-priority validation
COMMON_CAUSE: both lumens exposed to the same simulant simultaneously, measured per-lumen (isolated floor port sensor)

common_cause_condition.definition: both lumens exposed to the same obstruction simulant in the same trial; per-lumen occlusion state verified post-test
common_cause_condition.threshold_provenance: the R405-recorded proposal (external-audit quantification of the package's own recorded critical kill condition), registered at R406, frozen here
common_cause_condition.rule: KILL if the simulant occludes the floor lumen in >= 90% of the tested pressure/flow cases in the COMMON_CAUSE arm

primary_endpoint.name: residual floor-lumen steady-state flow in the PRIMARY_ONLY arm
secondary_endpoints: measured G ratio = G_floor/G_primary vs the modelled 0.0885 (+/- 30% Poiseuille-validity band)
integrated residual drainage volume over the protocol horizon

Q_min.provenance: literature CSF production range 0.2-0.4 mL/min (Tariq et al. 2023 PMC10409822; Silverberg et al. 2002 J Neurosurg 97(6):1271, web-search-verified snippets recorded in QMIN_FLOOR_FLOW_CALCULATION.json); the upper bound makes the pass rule strict, the lower bound mirrors it as the kill bound; the 0.2-0.4 band between them routes to MODIFY
Q_min.pass_rule: PASS requires residual floor flow >= 0.4 mL/min at >= 2 of the 3 heads
Q_min.kill_rule: KILL if residual floor flow < 0.2 mL/min at ALL heads

the_90pct_common_cause_rule.verbatim: KILL (channel a) if the simulant occludes the floor lumen in >= 90% of the tested pressure/flow cases in the COMMON_CAUSE arm — a safety floor occluded in the common-cause mode nearly always is not a safety floor

measurement_uncertainty.repeatability_rule: 3 repetitions per condition per sample; a condition-level criterion is met only if it holds in >= 2 of 3 repetitions; ALL raw traces reported (no selection)
measurement_uncertainty.steady_state_criterion: flow drift < 10% of mean over the final 5 minutes
measurement_uncertainty.false_pass_rule: a trial counts as PASS only if ALL hold: (1) primary obstruction verified post-test; (2) floor flow measured through the isolated floor port with the primary fixture independently blanked; (3) fixture leak test at 1.5x max head passes with leak <= 0.02 mL/min; (4) the single-lumen control fully obstructed reads < 0.02 mL/min; (5) steady state confirmed. Trials failing (1)-(5) are VOID and cannot count toward a pass (VOID trials are reported, never dropped).
measurement_uncertainty.uncertainty_statement: per-reading uncertainty is dominated by the flow-meter resolution class (<= 0.01 mL/min) plus drift criteria; condition-level uncertainty is addressed by the 2-of-3 repetition rule, not by averaging away variance

cost.range: $11-25K (external-audit itemization: loop $2-5K, extrusion samples $3-8K, simulants $1-2K, personnel $5-10K)

timeline.gating_item: sample procurement + apparatus build; no funded sponsor exists at registration time (REAL_BUYER = 0)

decision_rule.mapping_from_pre_registration: ACCEPT -> KEEP; INDETERMINATE -> MODIFY; KILL -> KILL
ordered_rules: R0 EXECUTION_INVALID: valid_trials_total <= 0 (every trial VOID) — an execution failure, not a technology verdict (Art. LXI)
R1 KILL channel c: manufacturing_minwall_all_failed = true
R3 KILL channel b: residual floor flow < 0.2 mL/min at ALL heads
R4 KEEP: residual flow >= 0.4 at >= 2 of 3 heads AND occlusion < 90% AND measured G ratio within +/- 30% of 0.0885

R5 MODIFY (otherwise): flow lands in the 0.2-0.4 INDETERMINATE band, or too few passing heads, or flows pass but the G ratio is outside the +/- 30% Poiseuille-validity band (the engineering model must be updated through the adjudication machinery and the contract re-registered for a re-run; never a promotion)
decision_rule.no_human_reinterpretation: the verdict is computed by the pure function from the observation record; every branch above is exercised by tests (tests/test_r407_first_reality_loop.py); a human may READ the rule trace but may not re-weigh the inputs

reality_boundary_interface.ingestion_contract: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/REALITY_INGESTION_CONTRACT.json (R407-B mandatory fields; the observation enters as a REALITY_EVENT and is adjudicated by the R407-C chain)
reality_boundary_interface.ledger: LEAD_PORTFOLIO_4/P04/REALITY_LOOP/REALITY_LEDGER.json (append-only, hash-chained; EMPTY until the first real observation)

safety: in-vitro bench only; no human/animal subjects; no implantation
honest_limits: obstruction simulants are analogs, not ex-vivo human tissue (transfer risk recorded)
water/CSF-mimic viscosity residual vs CSF (NIST 310.15 K water anchored; CSF slightly higher)
bench horizon excludes biological fouling timelines (chronic in-vivo obstruction differs from acute simulant occlusion)
the manufacturing observation is qualitative (process capability remains a recorded UNKNOWN)
constitutional_basis: Art. LII (falsification contract: there exists an outcome that kills the mechanism — channels a/b/c), Art. XXVII (threshold provenance: every threshold carries class + source + uncertainty), Art. XLVII (identical instrument across arms), Art. LI (a KILL must feed the cemetery and constrain future discovery), Art. LXI (execution failure is never a scientific verdict)
